integrity: The deduction uses Osękowski's explicit sharp full weak lower bound and the Ivanisvili--Mozolyako--Volberg universal restricted weak upper bound under the same dyadic A2 normalization. The multiplication reformulation between S on L2(w) and S_{w^{-1}} on L2(w^{-1}) is an exact isometry. No numerical computation, limiting interpolation, or unsupported same-weight lower estimate for the restricted constant is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem proves only a lower separation between the full and characteristic-input restricted weak constants along some dyadic A2 weights. It does not prove a matching same-weight upper asymptotic for their ratio and does not address alternative restricted-type conventions, continuous square functions, or strong L2 norms.
title: A logarithmic gap between full and restricted weak square-function bounds
